body:
Overview cards show only the list name. Standard shopping-list pattern: a
count of open (todo) items per list ("Supermercado · 7") so you can see at a
glance whether a trip is pending, before opening the list. Cheap on both
clients: Android ItemDao already filters by status (add a count-by-list
query, join in OverviewViewModel); web has all items in the sync store
(derive counts in OverviewPage).
title: Overview cards: show open-item count per list (both clients)
